source_semantics.scanner_metadata: The generated canonical ledger classifies this row as mutation=false and risk=low; this evidence preserves that scanner metadata rather than rewriting it.
source_semantics.predicate: FailExternal accepts a typed execution GUID and required owner identity, and mutates only the matching owner-scoped External execution while it is Running. A missing execution, wrong owner, wrong mode, or wrong state is a no-op.
source_semantics.transition: A successful transition sets status Failed, records the UTC completion time, stores the normalized failure text, and inserts an Error activity with the same failure message.
source_semantics.fallback: Blank failure text is normalized to the canonical fallback 'Approved change execution failed.'.

laravel_adaptation.external_boundary: Laravel's executions ledger is intrinsically approval-linked because approval_id is required, so the service does not invent an execution-mode column or a second execution store. The required approval relation is the approved/external execution boundary for this adapter.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_scope: Execution lookup uses the tenant-scoped Execution model under the active TenantContext and also requires actor_user_id to equal the supplied owner. Foreign-tenant, wrong-owner, missing, inactive-context, and non-running lookups return false without mutation.
laravel_adaptation.state_transition: Only a matching running execution is changed to failed with completed_at and failure set; the linked approval state is deliberately left unchanged because approval failure is owned by ApprovalWorkflowService.RecordExecutionFailed.
laravel_adaptation.activity: The same transaction appends immutable tenant-scoped AuditEvent activity with event execution.failed, Error level, canonical operation ID, execution/operation/correlation/approval/site identity, and the normalized message.
laravel_adaptation.redaction: Failure persistence and activity metadata redact credential-like assignments and cap the stored message at 1000 characters, preserving the Laravel variant's server-side secret boundary while keeping the source failure semantics.

proofs: same-tenant owned running execution transitions to failed with deterministic completed_at
failure text is trimmed, credential-redacted, and persisted without the secret value
blank failure uses the exact canonical fallback message
immutable tenant-scoped Error activity records the same safe message and canonical operation provenance
linked approval status remains unchanged, preserving the separate approval-state service boundary
wrong owner and non-running state are no-op transitions with no activity
foreign tenant direct operation UUID is treated as 404-equivalent not found and the foreign row remains unchanged
valid missing UUID and inactive tenant context fail closed without activity
malformed UUID and invalid owner identity are rejected before lookup
acceptance.external_runtime: No live WordPress/provider/email/payment/DNS/production/manual evidence is required because this operation is a tenant-local execution-ledger failure transition.
